data.name: AboutDescription
data.value: An open VPN/proxy client. It connects through the Xray-core and sing-box cores, which are separate programs with their own licenses.

data.name: AboutLicense
data.value: Licensed under Apache 2.0. Third-party components and their licenses are listed in the NOTICE file.

data.name: AutoNoWorkingProfile
data.value: No profile responded to the latency test.

data.name: AutoTooltip
data.value: Connect to the fastest profile and switch on failure

data.name: AutoWaiting
data.value: No server responds right now — Auto will try again at the next check.

data.name: ClipboardEmpty
data.value: The clipboard contains neither a link nor a QR code image.

data.name: ClipboardNoQr
data.value: No QR code was found in the clipboard image.

data.name: Failure_SystemProxyFailed
data.value: Could not enable the Windows system proxy.

data.value: Import: QR code, links or config

data.name: LatencyTooltipFormat
data.value: Latency through the tunnel over an established connection. First connection (tunnel and TLS setup): {0} ms

data.name: LinkCopiedFormat
data.value: The link for “{0}” was copied. It contains access keys — share it only with people you trust.

data.name: LogEmpty
data.value: The core log appears here: the latest lines while connected, and the lines that caused an error after a failure.

data.name: LogMaskedNote
data.value: Addresses and keys in the log are masked.

data.name: ModeProxyTooltip
data.value: Apps that use the Windows system proxy (browsers and most apps) go through KHORS

data.name: ModeTunTooltip
data.value: All traffic of this computer goes through KHORS, including games and apps without proxy support. Requires the running KHORS service (see Settings).

data.name: Problem_AuthenticationFailed
data.value: The server rejected the password. Check the password in the profile or update the subscription.

data.name: Problem_CertificateExpired
data.value: The server certificate has expired or is not yet valid. Check the date and time on this computer.

data.name: Problem_CertificateNameMismatch
data.value: The server certificate was issued for another name. Check the SNI (server name) in the profile.

data.name: Problem_CertificateUntrusted
data.value: The server certificate failed verification: it is self-signed or the connection is intercepted. Ask the server owner for the right settings.

data.name: Problem_ConfigRejected
data.value: The core rejected the configuration. Copy the core log and report it to the KHORS developers.

data.name: Problem_ConnectionRefused
data.value: The server refused the connection: nothing is listening on this port. Check the port in the profile or contact the server owner.

data.name: Problem_ConnectionReset
data.value: The connection to the server was reset. Your ISP may be blocking this protocol — try another profile.

data.name: Problem_ConnectionTimeout
data.value: The server does not respond: it is down, the port is closed by a firewall, or the address is blocked by your ISP.

data.name: Problem_NetworkUnreachable
data.value: No route to the server. Check your internet connection.

data.name: Problem_PortInUse
data.value: A local port is used by another program (for example, another VPN client). Close it and connect again.

data.name: Problem_RealityRejected
data.value: The server did not accept the REALITY handshake. Check the public key, short id and SNI in the profile, or update the subscription.

data.name: Problem_RealityRejected_SingBox
data.value: The server did not accept the REALITY handshake. Check the public key, short id, SNI and fingerprint; if the server runs Xray 26.9.8 or newer, switch the profile to the Xray core (profile menu → Core).

data.name: Problem_ServerNotFound
data.value: The server address was not found. Check the address in the profile and your internet connection.

data.name: Problem_TlsHandshakeFailed
data.value: The TLS handshake with the server failed. Check the SNI, fingerprint and port in the profile.

data.name: Problem_TunUnavailable
data.value: Failed to create the TUN adapter. Turn off any other VPN in TUN mode and connect again; if that does not help, reinstall the KHORS service.

data.name: ProfileUnknownParamsFormat
data.value: Link parameters KHORS does not understand yet: {0}

data.name: ProxyRecoveredAfterCrash
data.value: System proxy restored after KHORS terminated unexpectedly.

data.name: QrImageCopied
data.value: The image was copied to the clipboard.

data.name: QrTooLong
data.value: The link is too long for a QR code — use “Copy link”.

data.name: QrWarning
data.value: The code contains server access keys. Show it only to people you trust.

data.name: ScreenNoQr
data.value: No QR code was found on the screen. Open the image with the code on top of other windows and try again.

data.name: ServiceInstallTooltip
data.value: Install the KHORS service (Windows will ask for administrator rights)

data.name: ServiceRemoveTooltip
data.value: Remove the KHORS service (Windows will ask for administrator rights)

data.name: ServiceSetup_Cancelled
data.value: Cancelled: administrator rights were not granted.

data.name: ServiceSetup_Install_Failed
data.value: Failed to install the service. To see the reason, run “khors-service.exe install” in an administrator command prompt.

data.name: ServiceSetup_Install_Succeeded
data.value: The KHORS service is installed and running.

data.name: ServiceSetup_SetupNotFound
data.value: khors-service.exe is missing next to KHORS — the full KHORS build is required.

data.name: ServiceSetup_Uninstall_Failed
data.value: Failed to remove the service. To see the reason, run “khors-service.exe uninstall” in an administrator command prompt.

data.name: ServiceUntrusted
data.value: the service channel is taken by another process

data.name: SettingsModeHint
data.value: The mode can be changed while disconnected. TUN requires the KHORS service.

data.name: SettingsServiceHint
data.value: Needed only for TUN mode: it creates the network adapter and routes. Installed once; Windows will ask for administrator rights.

data.name: StorageCorrupt
data.value: The profiles file is damaged and was set aside; starting a new list.

data.name: StorageReadOnly
data.value: Profiles were saved by a newer KHORS version — changes are not saved.

data.name: StorageRestoredFromBackup
data.value: The profiles file was damaged — profiles restored from the backup.

data.name: SubscriptionError_HttpError
data.value: the subscription server returned an error

data.name: SubscriptionError_NoProfiles
data.value: the response contains no profiles in a known format

data.name: SubscriptionError_Timeout
data.value: the subscription server did not respond in time

data.name: SubscriptionError_TooLarge
data.value: the server response is too large

data.name: SubscriptionViaProxy
data.value: downloaded through KHORS — the subscription server is unreachable directly

data.name: TunConnectedFormat
data.value: Core: {0}. All traffic goes through the KHORS TUN adapter.

data.name: Unsupported_core
data.value: the profile is manually assigned to another core

data.name: Unsupported_protocol
data.value: Hysteria2, TUIC and WireGuard work only through sing-box

data.name: Unsupported_protocol_encryption
data.value: VLESS Encryption is available only in Xray

data.name: Unsupported_security
data.value: VLESS/Trojan without TLS to a public address

data.name: Unsupported_security_allowInsecure
data.value: disabled certificate verification (allowInsecure) was removed in Xray 26

data.name: Unsupported_security_mlDsa65Verify
data.value: the ML-DSA-65 key (pqv) is available only in Xray

data.name: Unsupported_security_pinnedPeerCertSha256
data.value: pinned certificate (pinSHA256): sing-box pins the public key, not the certificate — use a certificate from a trusted CA (e.g. Let's Encrypt)

data.name: Unsupported_security_supportsX25519MlKem768
data.value: the server expects X25519MLKEM768, which sing-box does not send — use the Xray core

data.name: Unsupported_security_verifyPeerCertByName
data.value: certificate verification by name (vcn) is available only in Xray

data.name: Unsupported_transport
data.value: the XHTTP transport is available only in Xray

data.name: Unsupported_transport_headerType
data.value: TCP HTTP header obfuscation is available only in Xray

data.name: Unsupported_transport_mode
data.value: gRPC multi mode is available only in Xray
